featured_reviews.name: Amit Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text: Very kind and cooperative Owners from the same Maharashtrian family.  A well-managed gym, with no monkey-business, unlike others in the area.  Spacious and clean with adequate range of equipment.  The Owners exercise good control over the Trainers to ensure no misbehaviour with ladies.  My wife and I switched gyms to join Growth Fitness as soon as Sandesh Sagvekar left his service in another gym in the area and decided to start Growth Fitness a little over a year ago.  Music is played at soft volume so that it does not damage auditory nerves.  The toilets are clean and kept dry.  The gym tends to get a little hot in summer months, owing to the tin roof.  A trainer who had once misbehaved with a young lady member was immediately reined in by the Owners to ensure decorum, which has definitely not been the experience at other gyms in the Kandarpada area of Dahisar West.  This is a GOOD gym that is unpretentious and has very good management.  My wife and I have been happy members here, after having experienced other gyms in the area that care "two hoots" for members and redressal of the complaints from members.  Rules of the gym are uniformly applied to all members, unlike the selective application of gym rules at the whims of managers and Trainers at other gyms in Kandarpada.  It is a "No Nonsense" gym.  Highly recommended.

The best part is they just to help you with workout but also organise events like treks and outdoor sports so you get to socialise with other gym members and also workout better. I would strongly recommend this gym for someone whose into some serious yet fun workouts.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: The experience at Growth Fitness hasn’t been great. If you go in the afternoon, be prepared to bring your own towel since only one AC is working, and it’s not sufficient for proper cooling. Go here only if you have no better options or can avoid the busy times.

I joined Good Life Fitness at 107 kg with one clear goal — fat loss without losing muscle. I didn’t just want to become “lighter.” I wanted proper body recomposition.

Three months later, I’m at 96 kg.

That’s 11 kg down, and the biggest difference is not just the number on the scale — it’s how I feel physically and mentally.

My trainer, Abhishek, played a huge role in this transformation.

What I appreciated most is that he never treated it like random workouts. He explained the technical aspects — proper form, muscle activation, progressive overload, recovery, and why certain movements matter for fat loss while preserving muscle. That knowledge made me confident instead of confused.

I started training 3 times a week. Once my stamina and recovery improved, we increased it to 5 sessions a week in the last two months. The progression was structured and safe. He pushed me hard, but never irresponsibly. I was challenged every session, yet I never felt like I was risking injury.

Nutrition was another major game changer. With his guidance, I started calorie counting and focusing seriously on diet. Not extreme dieting, not starvation — just discipline and consistency. That’s what made the difference.

When I saw the scale drop below 100 kg, it was a huge mental milestone for me. That moment felt powerful. It proved that consistency works.

If you’re someone who is overweight and serious about real transformation — not shortcuts — this gym and this trainer are worth it. The results are real, and I’m sharing my before-and-after pictures as proof.

Grateful for the guidance, structure, and push in the right direction.

Highly recommended.
